examples.title: From land to sea — the evolutionary pathways of whales
examples.description: 20 referenced slides in the Aquarelle theme: the whole road from the first cells, leaving the water (Tiktaalik), raoellids, Pakicetus, Ambulocetus, protocetids, basilosaurids, the Neoceti split, echolocation, gigantism, genomics, and the other returns to the sea.
